description: Behavioural negative cases for the UM v1 wire contract. These are HTTP-level expectations; the signed cryptographic cases are in test-vectors.v1.json.

cases.mutation: bootstrap token never issued
bootstrap token expired (TTL > 15 min)
bootstrap token already consumed
body contains a signature field (signature must be header-only)
X-UM-Pubkey does not match the key that signed the request
request body tampered after signing
signed_at outside the 300 s window
duplicate X-UM-Nonce header
missing X-UM-Content-Encoding (identity must be explicit)
stacked or non-gzip content encoding
signature created for /v1/agent/rotate reused on /v1/agent/report
same X-UM-Nonce reused with a different body
same report_id resent with different body bytes
report from a retired boot generation after a newer generation was accepted
seq lower than last accepted seq on the current boot
declared Content-Encoding gzip but body is not one gzip member
decoded body above the 128 KiB cap / compressed body above 256 KiB
duplicate X-UM-Signature or X-UM-Node-Id header
collected_at in the future (> sent_at + 60 s)
payload sent with sent_at outside the 300 s window while collected_at is old
rotate request signed by a key already revoked by an admin (no old-key grace timer exists in rev-5)
rotate body signs with the new key instead of the old key
report signature reused on config endpoint
node identity/signature headers sent to the web admin listener
admin session cookie sent to the ingest listener
enrollment transaction committed but response lost; retry with the used token

expected.recovery: admin revokes orphan active node and issues a new token

cases.mutation: same nonce+body retried while awaiting proof

expected.recovery: identical rotate-response replayed from persisted rotation record

cases.mutation: different nonce while a rotation is awaiting proof
retry after awaiting-proof deadline expired (rotation aborted)

expected.recovery: agent deletes provisional key, resumes old-key reporting

cases.mutation: old key used after rotation confirmed (new-key proof accepted)

expected.recovery: agent switches to confirmed new key; operator recovery only if no key proves valid

cases.mutation: seq == last_seq with an identical request fingerprint (lost ACK retry)
seq == last_seq with a different request fingerprint
nonce previously used on another endpoint (fingerprint differs)
boot generation lower than the persisted highest_gen (even if absent from the bounded boot_registry history)
valid signed report whose source is authorization-unproven/disabled in agent config

expected.recovery: source remains disabled; availability unavailable; no fabricated data

cases.mutation: boot generation lower than persisted highest generation

expected.recovery: operator revokes and re-enrolls; no in-place reset

cases.mutation: same generation but different boot_id
generation gap above MAX_BOOT_GAP (gen - highest_gen > 65535)
first report of new generation is a duplicate report_id (spool replay)

expected.recovery: transport generation/seq high-water still advanced in the same transaction

cases.mutation: agent boot-state file missing/corrupt while other state exists

expected.local: fail-closed; no generation reset or old boot_id reuse; operator recovery required

cases.mutation: same nonce+body retried with refreshed sent_at/seq/boot_gen within 300 s freshness

expected.recovery: identical persisted rotate-response; volatile transport fields are excluded from the rotate nonce fingerprint

cases.recovery: same persisted rotate-response after full boot/seq/nonce/identity/signature validation and a high-water commit; intent matching never bypasses transport validation or node_boot

cases.mutation: same rotation nonce with changed body/key or wrong endpoint
new-key proof report committed but ACK lost; retried under the new key

expected.recovery: any 2xx new-key response marks rotation confirmed; old key deleted

cases.mutation: rotation aborted (provisional key revoked, old active); new-key report then old-key fallback

expected.recovery: delete provisional key, resume old-key reporting

cases.mutation: both keys rejected after admin revocation

expected.recovery: stop reporting, keep spool, operator recovery

cases.mutation: generation forward jump of 2..65535 after consecutive offline restarts (first accepted request seq may be >1)

expected.high_water: highest_gen/current boot/last_seq set from the accepted request; boot_generation_gap audit entry written

cases.mutation: first attempt of a new generation was lost; retry reaches the center with seq=2

expected.high_water: last_seq=2 (the accepted request's seq, not forced to 1)

cases.mutation: generation gap exactly 65535 (MAX_BOOT_GAP boundary)
X-UM-Boot-Gen or X-UM-Seq above MAX_NUMERIC (9223372036854775806) or non-canonical decimal
report accepted with seq == MAX_NUMERIC (9223372036854775806), exhausting next_seq

expected.recovery: agent MUST NOT reuse seq; start a new generation on a clean restart or enter operator recovery; center rejects further same-generation requests

cases.mutation: same rotate nonce/body retried after a generation forward jump (refreshed boot_gen within MAX_BOOT_GAP, refreshed seq/sent_at) while awaiting proof

expected.recovery: identical persisted rotate-response after full signature/identity/boot/seq/nonce validation; node_boot high-water committed; no special retry path

cases.mutation: rotate intent retried with a generation lower than the persisted highest generation

expected.recovery: no rotate-response replay; agent stops for operator recovery if boot state is inconsistent

cases.mutation: rotate intent retried with a sequence that conflicts with the persisted high-water

expected.recovery: no rotate-response replay; validate boot/seq before intent replay

cases.mutation: rotate intent match with same generation but a different boot_id
windows_terminal snapshot is missing the terminal object
linux_vps node sends a snapshot with a terminal object
windows_terminal sends server fields (services/protocols/traffic/clients) outside their honest unavailable/null/empty state
terminal route token is not one of a_reality/a_hy2/b_reality/b_hy2/direct/unknown
active_connections.total does not equal the sum of by_route while availability is ok
availability=ok with a null route or null count fields, or unavailable with non-null fields
selection.sampled_at or active_connections.sampled_at outside [collected_at-300 s, collected_at+60 s] (independent sampling is allowed, unbounded skew is not)
operator-local route binding absent/ambiguous but the path would be classified as direct

expected.local: agent must classify unknown/null and must never emit direct without an explicit local binding; center accepts only the closed token form and cannot resolve local names

cases.mutation: privacy sentinel: raw proxy name, destination IP/URL, private YAML, controller secret or connection id placed in any terminal string field or as an extra field

expected.recovery: reject and audit; never store/log/echo the sentinel value

cases.mutation: route mapping version is changed after historical samples were recorded

expected.behavior: historical attribution is resolved with the mapping version effective at the sample/event time; the new version applies only from its effective_from; prior versions are never rewritten or deleted

cases.mutation: enroll request node_class does not match the admin-issued bootstrap-token scope
node_class and host.os disagree (linux_vps/windows or windows_terminal/linux)
windows_terminal sends a report-metrics body (not a v1 Windows payload)

contract_revision_note: Revision 5 changes: bounded generation forward jumps (MAX_BOOT_GAP=65535) are accepted; the first accepted request of a new generation may have seq>1; ACK next_seq is nullable on uint64-safe numeric exhaustion; rotate intent replay runs full boot/seq/nonce/identity validation without bypassing high-water; node_class/platform isolation and Windows six-token telemetry cases added. The superseded rev-4 expectations are retained below for traceability.

superseded_rev4_expectations.rev4_mutation: boot generation skips more than highest+1, or new generation first seq != 1
superseded_rev4_expectations.rev5_resolution: Only a gap > MAX_BOOT_GAP (65535) is rejected (NEG-BOOT-03). Gaps 1..65535 and first-contact seq>1 are accepted (NEG-BOOT-06/07/08).

superseded_rev4_expectations.rev4_mutation: rotate retried after the old key grace expired
superseded_rev4_expectations.rev5_resolution: No old-key grace timer exists; expiry aborts only the provisional key and the old key stays active (NEG-ROT-05). NEG-ROT-01 is reworded as a revoked-key rotate attempt.

superseded_rev4_expectations.rev4_mutation: agent boot-state file missing/corrupt while other state exists

rev4_expected.local: fail-closed; no generation reset or old boot_id reuse; operator recovery required

superseded_rev4_expectations.rev5_resolution: Unchanged fail-closed behavior; still no in-place reset and no old boot_id reuse.
